Scottish rates on non-savings income are devolved and unchanged; dividend rates are separate and unchanged. The Welsh adjustment and block-grant effects are separate rows.

experiments.note: Without the July 2022 alignment the primary threshold and lower profits limit stay indexed by CPI: £11,607, £11,804 a year (£223, £227 a week) in 2024-25 and 2025-26, held from April 2026 by Autumn Statement 2022's extension. Modern law has £12,570.
